leading_root_cause.title: Missing Python Dependency: 'pydantic_settings'
leading_root_cause.description: The build failed because Python module 'pydantic_settings' is not installed or not included in your environment specification.
leading_root_cause.remediation:
1. Add 'pydantic_settings' to your `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`, or `setup.cfg`.
2. Ensure the step installing dependencies (`pip install`, `poetry install`, `uv sync`) runs before executing code.
3. If using an isolated virtual environment, verify it is activated in this CI step.
leading_root_cause.detection_rationale: Matched signature 'DEP-001: Python Module Not Found' in log lines
